after: `switch` checks a value against choices called cases. In this example, it looks for the case matching choice.
After the chosen case finishes, the switch ends. Go only continues into the next case body if you explicitly use `fallthrough`.
`default` handles a value that matches no listed case. It is the fallback choice.
Checking a case does not change the value of choice. It only chooses which instructions run.
